checks.label: As both gears are keyed onto one shaft, they revolve at the same velocity: on every train drawn the two gears on a middle shaft turn at one speed and the same way, and nine turns of the motor pinion read 9, 3, 3 and 1 turns

To find a compound train's total reduction, find each stage's reduction and multiply them together: the speeds passed mesh by mesh give 9, 12, 50, 20, 36 and 30 overall, 1/12 for the crank train, and the tiles read 3 : 1, 3 : 1 and 9 : 1, then 4 : 1, 5 : 1 and 20 : 1

At every mesh speed × teeth is the same on both gears and the direction flips, so two stages turn the output the motor's way and three turn it anticlockwise; the fastest gear is the motor pinion on screen 1 and the 10-tooth pinion on screen 12
Each typed answer and slip is worked from the tooth counts: 2 turns (6, 3, 162), 120.8 rev/min (207.1, 483.3, 17400), 25 N m (1000, 40000, 0.025), 90 teeth (270, 540) and 80 rev/min (240, 72000)

An ideal train keeps the power, torque × speed, the same on every shaft: speed falls to a ninth as torque grows nine times; 5000 N × 0.2 m = 1000 N m at the drum is 20 N m at an ideal 50 : 1 motor, and 4000 N × 0.25 m through 40 : 1 is 25 N m
Turning the motor forward winds the cable onto the drum and lifts the load: two motor turns lift it by the drum's radius × two ninths of a turn

Before an answer nothing gives it away: the middle-shaft and output counters read "? turns", the output speeds and the motor's torque read "?", the wheels hide behind "? teeth", and only the motor shows its way round; after it, each is shown
Every mesh is drawn with its gears touching at their pitch circles and tooth in gap, gears on one shaft share a centre, and no two gears in one layer overlap unless they mesh
Dragged tooth counts set the ratios: 10 into 60 twice reads 6 : 1, 6 : 1 and 36 : 1, and 60 into 10 twice speeds up, reading 0.17 : 1, 0.17 : 1 and 0.03 : 1
Every demonstration is over within 5 s of its screen opening and nothing moves during the 0.35 s screen fade; every answer's motion is over within 2.5 s
